    Arbitrary-field E-finiteness criteria for right modules #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.moduleCriteria (k R : Type u) [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] :
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ EqualClassHom (FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ)) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ EqualClassBrickHom (FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ)) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (W : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty (FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ)) (h : IsWideClass W), Function.Injective ⇑h.inclusionK₀) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (M : FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ), FunctoriallyFinite (generatedTorsionClass M)) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (g : ProjectiveClass Rᵐᵒᵖ), (semistableSimpleClasses ((projectiveClassWeight k) g)).Finite) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (B : FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ), IsBrick B → FunctoriallyFinite (generatedTorsionClass B)) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ NumericallyDisjointTorsionPairs (FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ)) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (W : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty (FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ)), IsWideClass W → FunctoriallyFinite W) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (B : FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ), IsBrick B → FunctoriallyFinite (FilteredBy B)) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (s : Set (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ))), IsSemibrick s → s.Finite → s.ncard = (simpleIsomorphismClasses Rᵐᵒᵖ).ncard → s = simpleIsomorphismClasses Rᵐᵒᵖ) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (s : Set (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ))), IsSemibrick s → s.Finite) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (r : ℕ), 0 < r → (brickClassesOfEndolength k r).Finite) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (g : ProjectiveClass Rᵐᵒᵖ) (r : ℕ), 0 < r → (stableClassesOfEndolength k ((projectiveClassWeight k) g) r).Finite) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ PolynomialBrickGrowth Rᵐᵒᵖ) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ BrickWallFaces k) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (X Y : FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ), IsBrick X → IsBrick Y → realStabilityWall k X = realStabilityWall k Y → Nonempty (X ≅ Y)) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ¬∃ (M : ModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ), IsGenericBrick k M) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ RightUniversalLocalizationsFinite k R) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (B : Type u) [inst : Ring B] [IsSimpleRing B] [IsArtinianRing B] (f : R →+* B) (hf : IsRingEpimorphism f), Module.Finite k B)

    Module-theoretic equivalences, with E-finiteness as the reference condition and all finite module categories taken in the right-module convention.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.compositionVectorCriteria (k R : Type u) [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Infinite k] :
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (d : ↑(simpleIsomorphismClasses Rᵐᵒᵖ) → ℕ), (brickClassesOfClass (classOfCompositionVector k d)).Finite) ∧ (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ ↔ ∀ (g : ProjectiveClass Rᵐᵒᵖ) (d : ↑(simpleIsomorphismClasses Rᵐᵒᵖ) → ℕ), (stableClassesOfClass ((projectiveClassWeight k) g) (classOfCompositionVector k d)).Finite) ∧ ((∃ (r : ℕ), 0 < r ∧ (brickClassesOfEndolength k r).Infinite) ↔ ∃ (d : ↑(simpleIsomorphismClasses Rᵐᵒᵖ) → ℕ), (brickClassesOfClass (classOfCompositionVector k d)).Infinite)

    The ordinary composition-vector criteria and brick-continuity over an infinite field, in the right-module convention.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.finiteFieldGrowthDichotomy (k R : Type u) [Field k] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Finite k] :
    (IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ → PolynomialBrickGrowth Rᵐᵒᵖ) ∧ (¬IsEFinite Rᵐᵒᵖ → ∃ (c : ℝ) (m₀ : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ m ≥ m₀, ∃ (s : Finset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ))), Real.exp (c * ↑m) ≤ ↑s.card ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ (M : FGModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ), CategoryTheory.toSkeleton M = x ∧ IsBrick M ∧ FGModuleCat.moduleLength M ≤ m)

    The polynomial and exponential alternatives over a finite field.
